chunks: Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said: Protect your belief by charity; guard your wealth by paying Allāh’s share; and ward off the waves of calamity by praying.
ai.seo_question: How can charity and prayer protect faith and wealth according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) outlines a triad of spiritual safeguards, linking charitable giving to the preservation of faith and wealth, while positioning supplication as the shield against divine trials. This teaching reflects the Shia emphasis on the interplay between material acts of worship (zakat/sadaqah) and spiritual resilience (du'a) in maintaining a balanced life. The metaphor of 'calming waves' for du'a underscores its power to mitigate the turbulence of worldly hardships.
